hero_kpi_rationale: Key measure of segment performance and a vital indicator for understanding underlying profitability drivers and business trends at Aflac, particularly for Aflac Japan which generates the majority of earnings.

kpis.description: Pretax adjusted earnings of the company for Aflac Japan, a key indicator of financial performance for insurance segments.

kpis.name: Net Earned Premiums
kpis.explanation: Net earned premiums from insurance operations, key revenue metric for insurance segment performance
kpis.description: Net earned premiums generated by the company for Aflac Japan, a key indicator of insurance revenue.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Investment Income
kpis.explanation: Adjusted net investment income after amortized hedge costs, measuring investment performance impact on earnings
kpis.description: Adjusted net investment income of the company for Aflac Japan, after deduction of amortized hedging costs.
kpis.signal: Decline in adjusted net investment income

kpis.name: Pretax Adjusted Earnings
kpis.explanation: Pretax adjusted earnings measure used to evaluate segment performance and underlying profitability drivers
kpis.description: Pretax adjusted earnings of the company for Aflac Japan, a key indicator of financial performance for insurance segments.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Fair value of fixed income securities
kpis.explanation: Valeur de marché totale du portefeuille obligataire d'Aflac, reflétant l'exposition aux taux et au crédit.
kpis.description: Aflac's fixed income securities portfolio shows a fair value of $79.6 Bn as of 12/31/2025, compared to an amortized cost of $81.4 Bn, reflecting net unrealized losses of approximately $1.8 Bn. Primary concentration is in government bonds (41.5%) and corporate securities (30%).

kpis.name: Gross unrealized losses on fixed income securities
kpis.explanation: Montant total des moins-values latentes sur le portefeuille obligataire, indicateur clé du risque de taux et de crédit.
kpis.description: Gross unrealized losses on fixed income securities totaled $6.655 Bn as of 12/31/2025, primarily concentrated in government bonds ($4.442 Bn) and other corporates ($1.131 Bn), reflecting the high rate environment.
kpis.signal: Elevated unrealized losses, higher rate environment

kpis.name: Privately issued securities (fair value)
kpis.explanation: Valeur de marché des titres placés en privé, principalement détenus par Aflac Japan pour optimiser le rendement et l'adossement actif-passif.
kpis.description: Privately issued securities reached $16.2 Bn in fair value as of 12/31/2025 versus $15.7 Bn in 2024 (+3.0%), primarily driven by Aflac Japan's strategy to secure returns exceeding Japanese government bonds.

kpis.name: Aflac Japan USD investment program (amortized cost)
kpis.explanation: Encours total des investissements en dollars américains détenus par Aflac Japan et couverts contre le risque de change yen/dollar.
kpis.description: Aflac Japan's USD investment program reached $23.5 Bn in amortized cost as of 12/31/2025 versus $21.3 Bn in 2024 (+10.3%), reflecting an active diversification strategy toward higher-yielding assets hedged into yen.

kpis.name: Reverse dual-currency securities (% of total)
kpis.explanation: Part des titres à principal en yen et intérêts en USD dans le portefeuille total, outil de gestion du risque de change et de rendement.
kpis.description: Reverse dual-currency securities represented 5.0% of the total portfolio as of 12/31/2025 (versus 5.3% in 2024), with outstanding balances of $4.091 Bn compared to $4.313 Bn, demonstrating a measured reduction in this hybrid yen/USD exposure.

risks.title: Fluctuations in yen/dollar foreign exchange rates
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned prominently in the Risk Factors section and detailed extensively in Item 7A. The company is significantly exposed through its Japan operations and substantial yen-denominated investments. Exchange rate fluctuations directly impact the translation of yen-denominated assets/liabilities into USD for reporting, and the company notes potential for significant cash strain at the parent company level from derivative settlements and collateral requirements.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on fixed income investments
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate risk is identified as a primary market risk factor affecting the company's investment portfolio. The company holds a significant portion of fixed maturity securities which are sensitive to rate changes. Item 7A explicitly identifies this as one of the primary market risks monitored regularly.

risks.title: Credit risk on fixed income securities
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that a significant portion of the investment portfolio is composed of fixed maturity securities, exposing the company to counterparty credit risk. The company monitors credit risk through various strategies, suggesting material exposure.

risks.title: Geographic concentration of investments in Japan
risks.score_rationale: The company's Japan segment generates the vast majority of earnings and the investment portfolio shows significant concentration in yen-denominated securities. The MD&A indicates that Aflac Japan's functional currency is the yen and a material portion of the portfolio supports yen-denominated liabilities, creating concentration risk.

risks.title: Derivative and hedging program risks
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A details extensive use of foreign currency forwards, options, and other derivatives for hedging purposes. The company acknowledges rollover risk, basis risk, and the potential for significant derivative losses during periods of yen movement. The company notes explicit risks from shorter-duration derivatives hedging longer-duration investments.

risks.title: Liquidity strain from foreign exchange derivatives settlement
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A explicitly states that if yen strengthens significantly, this could cause cash strain at the parent company from derivative cash settlements and collateral requirements, and notes this could be significant depending on timing and severity of rate movements. The company manages this through ongoing hedging program adjustments.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the document.
